basic_details.job_title: ISI Research Associate Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: One temporary Research Associate (RA) post is open in the Theoretical Statistics and Mathematics Unit, Kolkata (TSMUK) of the Indian Statistical Institute (an autonomous body funded by the Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation, Government of India). The pay is a consolidated ₹58,000, ₹61,000 or ₹67,000 a month (Category-I, II or III) plus HRA as per Institute rules. The tenure is initially one year, up to a maximum of 2 years. Candidates need a Ph.D. in Statistics or Mathematics with at least one SCI journal publication, and must apply by email to [email protected] by 13 December

age_limit.details: The age limit is 35 years as on 13 December 2026. | Category Relaxation SC/ST/OBC/Women and differently abled candidates Usual relaxation Exceptionally bright candidates with relevant research experience Age may be relaxed

qualification.details: Minimum qualification: Ph.D. degree in Statistics or Mathematics with at least one publication in a Science Citation Index (SCI) Journal. Candidates who have submitted their thesis may also apply. Researchers, particularly those who have recently obtained their PhD degree, are encouraged to apply. | The selected candidate will be placed in Category-I, II or III depending on qualification and experience, as per DST OM No. SR/S9/Z-08/2018 dated 30 January 2019 and DST/PCPM/Z-06/2022 dated 26 June 2023. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

how_to_apply: Applications go by email to the Head, Theoretical Statistics and Mathematics Unit, Kolkata, and must be submitted by 13 December 2026.
Write an email to [email protected] with the subject header "Application for RA".
Attach a cover letter addressed to the Professor-in-Charge, Theoretical Statistics and Mathematics Division, Indian Statistical Institute.
Attach a current resume in English containing items (a) to (j) listed below.
Attach your list of publications and preprints, a research statement, copies of papers/preprints, ID proof and category documents.

Ask at least two referees, including your thesis supervisor, to email their recommendation letters directly to [email protected] with the subject header "Reference letter for <name of the candidate>" by 13 December 2026.

content_sections.heading: ISI Research Associate (RA) at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

Initially one year; up to a maximum of 2 years

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Minimum qualification: Ph.D. degree in Statistics or Mathematics with at least one publication in a Science Citation Index (SCI) Journal. Candidates who have submitted their thesis may also apply. Researchers, particularly those who have recently obtained their PhD degree, are encouraged to apply. The selected candidate will be placed in Category-I, II or III depending on qualification and experience, as per DST OM No. SR/S9/Z-08/2018 dated 30 January 2019 and DST/PCPM/Z-06/2022 dated 26 June 2023. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post. The age limit is 35 years as on 13 December 2026.

rows.category: Exceptionally bright candidates with relevant research experience

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: HRA is paid on top of these emoluments as per the rules of the Institute. If the Institute is unable to provide hostel accommodation, House Rent Allowance is payable with the respective emoluments as per the rules of the Institute. The appointment is purely on a temporary, contractual basis. It is initially for one year from the date of joining and may be extended or terminated earlier, depending on availability of funds and the performance of the candidate. Based on performance, the term of research associateship can be up to a maximum period of 2 years.

content_sections.heading: ISI Research Associate (RA) Job Description
content_sections.text: Research Associates are expected to get involved in teaching and research work in Statistics/Mathematics.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ISI Research Associate (RA)
content_sections.text: Applications go by email to the Head, Theoretical Statistics and Mathematics Unit, Kolkata, and must be submitted by 13 December 2026. Write an email to [email protected] with the subject header "Application for RA". Attach a cover letter addressed to the Professor-in-Charge, Theoretical Statistics and Mathematics Division, Indian Statistical Institute. Attach a current resume in English containing items (a) to (j) listed below. Attach your list of publications and preprints, a research statement, copies of papers/preprints, ID proof and category documents. Ask at least two referees, including your thesis supervisor, to email their recommendation letters directly to [email protected] with the subject header "Reference letter for <name of the candidate>" by 13 December 2026. (a) Name (in block letters); (b) Permanent/Present Address; (c) E-mail Address; (d) Telephone/Mobile No.; (e) Parent's Name/Spouse's Name; (f) Date of birth (g) Academic Qualifications, with percentage of marks obtained in each examination starting from 10th class (h) Experience (if any); (i) Date of submission of Ph.D. thesis/Date of receipt of the Ph.D. degree; (j) List of post-doctoral positions (if any) (k) List of publications and preprints; (l) a research statement including a summary of work done; (m) copies of papers/preprints At least two recommendation letters, including one from the thesis supervisor (n) Aadhaar Card/ Voter Card/ Pan Card; (o) SC/ST/OBC/Differently abled status along with all documents/certificates/testimonials

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Applications will be short-listed. Short-listed candidates will be asked to give a seminar followed by an interaction with the faculty. A merit list will be prepared, and if the selected candidate fails to produce the original documents and medical fitness certificate at joining, the Institute will offer the position to the next candidate in that merit list. The notice does not give a date for the seminar.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in ISI Recruitment 2026 for Research Associate?
faq.answer: There is one (01) Research Associate (RA) position in the Theoretical Statistics and Mathematics Unit, Kolkata (TSMUK).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the ISI Research Associate post?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted by email by 13 December 2026; recommendation letters must also reach by 13 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the ISI Research Associate post?
faq.answer: A Ph.D. degree in Statistics or Mathematics with at least one publication in a Science Citation Index (SCI) Journal is needed; candidates who have submitted their thesis may also apply.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the ISI Research Associate post?
faq.answer: The age limit is 35 years as on 13 December 2026, with usual relaxation for SC/ST/OBC/Women and differently abled candidates; age may also be relaxed for exceptionally bright candidates with relevant research experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of an ISI Research Associate?
faq.answer: The consolidated monthly emoluments are ₹58,000, ₹61,000 or ₹67,000 for Category-I, II and III respectively, depending on qualification and experience.

faq.question: Q6. Is HRA paid on top of the ISI Research Associate pay?
faq.answer: Yes, HRA is paid as per the rules of the Institute; if the Institute cannot provide hostel accommodation, House Rent Allowance is payable with the respective emoluments.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for the ISI Research Associate post?
faq.answer: Email the cover letter, resume in English and documents to [email protected] with the subject header "Application for RA" by 13 December 2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the ISI Research Associate post?
faq.answer: Short-listed candidates will be asked to give a seminar followed by an interaction with the faculty.

faq.question: Q9. Is the ISI Research Associate post permanent?
faq.answer: No, the post is filled purely on a contractual basis, initially for one year and up to a maximum of 2 years based on performance, with no right to claim permanent employment.

faq.question: Q10. What subject should referees use when sending recommendation letters?
faq.answer: Recommenders should email the letters directly to [email protected] with the subject header "Reference letter for <name of the candidate>" by 13 December 2026.
